classes.name: GccAna_Circ2dBisec
classes.summary:
This class describes functions for building bisecting curves between two 2D circles. A bisecting curve between two circles is a curve such that each of its points is at the same distance from the two circles. It can be an ellipse, hyperbola, circle or line, depending on the relative position of the two circles. The algorithm computes all the elementary curves which are solutions. There is no solution if the two circles are coincident. A Circ2dBisec object provides a framework for:
- defining the construction of the bisecting curves,
- implementing the construction algorithm, and consulting the result.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Constructs bisecting curves between the two circles Circ1 and Circ2.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: This method returns True if the construction algorithm succeeded.

instanceMethods.name: NbSolutions
instanceMethods.comment: This method returns the number of solutions. Raises NotDone if the construction algorithm didn't succeed.

instanceMethods.name: ThisSolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the solution number Index Raises OutOfRange exception if Index is greater than the number of solutions. It raises NotDone if the construction algorithm didn't succeed.

classes.name: GccAna_CircLin2dBisec
classes.summary:
Describes functions for building bisecting curves between a 2D line and a 2D circle. A bisecting curve between a circle and a line is a curve such that each of its points is at the same distance from the circle and the line. It can be a parabola or a line, depending of the relative position of the line and the circle. The algorithm computes all the elementary curves which are solutions. A CircLin2dBisec object provides a framework for:
- defining the construction of the bisecting curves,
- implementing the construction algorithm, and
- consulting the result.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Constructs bisecting curves between the circle Circle and the line Line.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true (this construction algorithm never fails).

instanceMethods.name: NbSolutions
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of curves, representing solutions computed by this algorithm.

instanceMethods.name: ThisSolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the solution number Index and raises OutOfRange exception if Index is greater than the number of solutions Exceptions Standard_OutOfRange if Index is less than zero or greater than the number of solutions computed by this algorithm.

classes.name: GccAna_Lin2dBisec
classes.summary:
Describes functions for building bisecting lines between two 2D lines. A bisecting line between two lines is such that each of its points is at the same distance from the two lines. If the two lines are secant, there are two orthogonal bisecting lines which share the angles made by the two straight lines in two equal parts. If D1 and D2 are the unit vectors of the two straight lines, those of the two bisecting lines are collinear with the following vectors:
- D1 + D2 for the "internal" bisecting line,
- D1 - D2 for the "external" bisecting line. If the two lines are parallel, the (unique) bisecting line is the straight line equidistant from the two straight lines. If the two straight lines are coincident, the algorithm returns the first straight line as the solution. A Lin2dTanObl object provides a framework for:
- defining the construction of the bisecting lines,
- implementing the construction algorithm, and
- consulting the result.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Constructs bisecting lines between the two lines Lin1 and Lin2.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True when the algorithm succeeded.

instanceMethods.name: NbSolutions
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of solutions and raise NotDone if the constructor wasn't called before.

instanceMethods.name: ThisSolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the solution number Index . The first solution is the inside one and the second is the outside one. For the first solution the direction is D1+D2 (D1 is the direction of the first argument and D2 the direction of the second argument). For the second solution the direction is D1-D2. Raises NotDone if the construction algorithm didn't succeed. It raises OutOfRange if Index is greater than the number of solutions.

instanceMethods.name: Intersection1
instanceMethods.signature: (Index: number, ParSol: number, ParArg: number, PntSol: gp_Pnt2d): { ParSol: number; ParArg: number }

instanceMethods.name: Intersection2
instanceMethods.signature: (Index: number, ParSol: number, ParArg: number, PntSol: gp_Pnt2d): { ParSol: number; ParArg: number }

classes.name: GccAna_LinPnt2dBisec
classes.summary:
Describes functions for building bisecting curves between a 2D line and a point. A bisecting curve between a line and a point is such a curve that each of its points is at the same distance from the circle and the point. It can be a parabola or a line, depending on the relative position of the line and the circle. There is always one unique solution. A LinPnt2dBisec object provides a framework for:
- defining the construction of the bisecting curve,
- implementing the construction algorithm, and
- consulting the result.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Constructs a bisecting curve between the line Line1 and the point Point2.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the algorithm succeeded.

instanceMethods.name: ThisSolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of solutions. It raises NotDone if the construction algorithm didn't succeed.

classes.name: GccAna_Pnt2dBisec
classes.summary:
This class implements the algorithms used to create the bisecting line between two 2d points Describes functions for building a bisecting line between two 2D points. The bisecting line between two points is the bisector of the segment which joins the two points, if these are not coincident. The algorithm does not find a solution if the two points are coincident. A Pnt2dBisec object provides a framework for:
- defining the construction of the bisecting line,
- implementing the construction algorithm, and consulting the result.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Constructs a bisecting line between the points Point1 and Point2.

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true (this construction algorithm never fails).

instanceMethods.name: HasSolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this algorithm has a solution, i.e. if the two points are not coincident.

instanceMethods.name: ThisSolution
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a line, representing the solution computed by this algorithm.
